blocks.text: Tetracycline genus Streptomyces ke mitti ke bacteria se hasil antibiotic hai. Yeh munh se li jane wali bacteriostatic antibiotic hai jo chlamydia aur syphilis jaise infections mein use hoti aur bacterial protein banna rok kar kaam karti hai. Ise doodh ki cheezon ya iron supplements ke saath nahi lena chahiye. Aam zimni asraat mein matli, ulti, dast aur dhoop se hassasiyat shamil hain.

items: Bacteriostatic: yeh bacteria ko seedha maarne ke bajaye un ki barhotri aur afzaish rokti hai.
Yeh Gram-positive aur Gram-negative dono bacteria ke khilaf kaam karti hai.
Yeh bacterial cells mein ja kar 30S ribosomal subunit se waqti taur par jurti hai.
Wahan jur kar yeh aminoacyl-tRNA ko acceptor (A) site se jurne nahi deti, is liye translation aur protein banna ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Tetracycline kis ribosomal subunit se jurti aur kya rokti hai?
blocks.explanation: 30S subunit; yeh aminoacyl-tRNA ko A site mein aane se rok kar translation band karti hai.

items: Tetracycline: Streptomyces se; bacteriostatic; wasee daira.
30S subunit se jur kar A site par tRNA rokti.
